title: aira tenorei
intro: Aira tenorei, commonly known as Wood Meadow-grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in soothing digestive issues, reducing stress, and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Aira tenorei include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
